title: Digital Bundle Studio — Reintroduce subtle color accents across theme and key surfaces

requirements.summary: Rework global CSS theme tokens to add subtle, cohesive accent tinting across light/dark modes while preserving Tailwind token mapping and readable contrast.
acceptanceCriteria: In light mode and dark mode, the UI surfaces (page background, cards, muted panels) show a subtle color tint rather than appearing purely gray/white.
Primary and ring colors feel consistent with the rest of the palette (no clashing accents), and focus rings remain clearly visible.
Text contrast remains readable across header, cards, muted panels, and buttons (no low-contrast body text on tinted surfaces).
No user-facing text is changed as part of the theme-token update.

file_operations.description: Adjust existing CSS variables for light and dark themes (e.g., --background/--card/--popover/--muted/--accent/--secondary/--border/--input/--ring and related foregrounds) to introduce a subtle, cohesive color tint while maintaining contrast and preserving the current Tailwind token mapping. Ensure focus-visible ring/offset remains clearly visible. Use the shadcn-ui token approach (CSS variables consumed by Tailwind color mapping) to keep components consistent. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update AppLayout styling so the header and main container reflect the refreshed accent palette without altering layout structure or navigation behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The header and main page background visually reflect the updated accent palette (for example, subtle gradient, tinted backdrop, or accent border), while keeping the same controls and placement.
All existing header buttons (“Storefront”, “Instructions”, “Preview”, “Export”, auth button) continue to function and remain accessible with clear hover/focus states.
No changes to routing/view-state logic; this is purely visual styling.

file_operations.description: Refine header and shell surface styling to pick up the updated accent palette (e.g., slightly tinted/gradient header backdrop, accent-aware borders/dividers, and/or subtle backdrop on the main container) while keeping the same structure and behavior. Ensure interactive states remain clear using existing shadcn-ui Button variants and theme tokens. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Refresh surfaces and interactive states in Export, Unified Preview, Storefront, Storefront product cards, and Product Editor to align with the updated accent palette without changing features or copy.
acceptanceCriteria: Export screen bundle cards, instructions panel, and primary actions visually show subtle color accents consistent with the global theme.
Unified Preview cards and “Show more/less” affordances retain current behavior and empty states, but look more visually lively via the updated palette.
Storefront grid/cards retain current structure and behavior, while the cards and CTA feel more color-accented and less monochrome.
Product Editor retains current form structure and behavior; section styling and interactive states reflect the updated palette.
No new screens, no new actions, and no copy changes are introduced in these updates.

file_operations.description: Update screen-level and Card-level class styling to better reflect the new accent-tinted surfaces (e.g., more expressive card borders/background overlays, hover/focus states, and section dividers) while keeping all behaviors intact. Keep using shadcn-ui Card/Button/Badge/Alert/Table components and the updated tokens for consistency. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust card surface treatments and the 'Show more/less' affordance styling to feel more accent-aware (e.g., subtle tinted panels, improved dividers, and more vibrant hover/focus states) while retaining current behavior and empty states. Keep using shadcn-ui Card/Button and theme tokens. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Refine screen container styling (header area and grid surroundings) to pick up the accent-tinted palette without altering layout structure or navigation behavior. Keep using shadcn-ui Button and theme tokens. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update product card surface and interaction styling (hover, focus-within ring, borders, media header background, and CTA emphasis) to align with refreshed accent tokens while keeping structure and behavior unchanged. Keep using shadcn-ui Card/Button and theme tokens. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Enhance editor surface hierarchy (main card, tab list area, empty-state panels, inner module cards, and section separators) so tinted muted/accent surfaces and interactive states reflect the updated palette without changing form structure or behavior. Keep using shadcn-ui Card/Tabs/Button/Input/Textarea/Badge and theme tokens. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
